description: Land Acquisition - Compensation of the land in Rambattha, Mawathagama D/S Division, Kurunegala District has been credited to the District Court  Kurunegala
categorisation: This gazette notice is exclusively about land acquisition matters under the Land Acquisition Act. It details the statutory compensation deposit for specific land parcels (Lot numbers 15 and 16) in the Rambawatta village, including case numbers, plan numbers, and land extent. The content is published in the "PART III – LANDS" section and deals solely with the administrative process of government land acquisition and compensation, fitting the definition of a Land Gazette.
